points.description: States that in the best case insertion sort performs N operations, where N is the number of elements/array length. Accept N operations, N-1 comparisons (equivalent linear count), or 'linear in N' as the operation count.
points.partial_credit: Partial credit for saying only O(N)/linear time without giving N or N-1 as the operation count.

levels.says: Says the best case takes linear time / O(N) but does not state N or N-1 as the number of operations.

points.description: Identifies the best-case scenario as an array that is already sorted (in the required order; for ascending sort, already in ascending order). Accept 'sorted array', 'already in order', or equivalent.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both the best-case operation count (N, or N-1 comparisons, linear in array length) and the best-case condition (the array is already sorted). A response that gives only one of these earns only that point. O(N) alone without identifying N as the operation count earns partial credit on P1; 'reverse sorted' or 'random order' does not earn P2.
